The only remaining raw strings are P1 (transformation description, admin q), identity/OIDC, cursor and codes. The archive reason uses z.string().trim().min(3) (P1-style reason, blank-safe). The diff scan found no secrets, CDN URLs, eval or dangerouslySetInnerHTML. A Unicode residual in the shared helpers is raised separately as F-DG2-160 (see SEC-R3-03).

checks_run.procedure: Probe zz-sec-r3-probe.test.ts (9 tests) on a disposable PG, twice. Unicode whitespace that ECMAScript trim covers (NBSP, U+3000, LS/PS, BOM, U+2007, U+205F, U+1680, U+202F) on charter outOfScope and changeSummary. P2 inputs not in the implementer's blank-text suite: journey nested step name/actor/systems[1], failureDemand, journey PATCH (partial merge) description, evidence review note, G1 submission note, decision PATCH title, decision option title. Each response must be a 400 with validation.blank at the pointer, no new row, version unchanged, and 0 audit rows for the request id. Control: actor "" is accepted. The same invocation also runs zz-sec-r3-invisible.test.ts, the F-DG2-160 reproduction, which is why the process exit is 1. Schema-level matrix of 18 code points via Node 24 type stripping.

checks_run.expected: every blank input -> 400 validation.blank at the exact (nested) pointer; nothing written; no audit event
checks_run.actual: zz-sec-r3-probe.test.ts 9/9 PASS in both runs. All listed inputs gave [400, validation, <pointer>:validation.blank, 0 audit rows], e.g. /steps/0/systems/1, /steps/0/actor, /note, /submissionNote, /title. Journey count, evidence version and gate_submission count were unchanged; the control returned 201. Residual: zz-sec-r3-invisible.test.ts failed 5/5 in both runs (process exit 1). Text made only of U+0085 NEL (Unicode White_Space) or Cf format characters (U+200B, U+200F, U+061C, U+2060) is accepted (201), and the B0041 pre-check reads 'pass'. The matrix shows trim() misses U+0085, U+180E, U+200B-D, U+2060, U+3164, U+2800, U+00AD, U+061C, U+200F. Raised as F-DG2-160 (Low, non-mandatory). The D-063 behaviour as specified (ECMAScript whitespace-only rejected with no write and no audit) holds.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-143 is CLOSED_VERIFIED: under concurrent load on Node 22 and 24, 520/520 tests pass, the AST walk peaks at 2.9 s against an explicit 30 s timeout, and no default-timeout test exceeds 1.87 s. D-063 holds as specified: every P2 body goes through freeText schemas (nested and partial PATCH included), and a blank value returns 400 at the field's pointer with nothing written and no audit row. The exclusions pre-check change left authz, If-Match/409 and audit unchanged, and the web retry test was strengthened, not weakened. All 13 required checks pass, including two integration runs (456/456, 19 migrations, contract 161 ops, AUD-403 sweep) and historical DG0/DG1. One new Low, non-mandatory finding: F-DG2-160. Invisible-only text (U+0085 NEL, zero-width and bidi marks) evades trim()-based freeText and hasText, so the B0041 exclusions pre-check reads 'pass'.
